title: FileNode/set skips accountNotFound check
description: handle_filenode_set (crate-jmap-filenode-server/src/filenode.rs) never calls backend.account_exists, so FileNode/set on an unknown accountId succeeds with an empty /set response instead of RFC 8620 §3.6.2 accountNotFound. Canonical jmap-mail-server Mailbox/set (mailbox.rs) checks account_exists after extract_account_id. Found while implementing JMAP-x2gd.46.1.
close_reason: Batch 11: committed and adversarially verified (or already fixed); CI green at cc87669d
